results.title: Tommy Pham, Dane Myers Trade Jabs After Reds Outfielder Dropped Fly Ball in Loss to Cardinals
results.description: Cincinnati Reds centerfielder Dane Myers pushed back against criticism from Philadelphia Phillies minor league outfielder Tommy Pham regarding Myers' game-deciding missed catch in a Thursday loss to the St. Louis Cardinals.
